risk_note: RV2 money (apps/api/src/modules/payout/**, app.module, entry.ts, platform queue catalog / worker-plan / event types): payout process assembly PayoutModule.forPayout (transfer / query handlers, channel by PAYOUT_MODE: FakeChannel or AlipayChannel, live only in prod with all secrets, start-up log without secrets). Per D10-326 the payout process connects only as couli_payout and never reads or writes users, ledger or config_items. Per D10-398 ① (member blocking, BR-WDR-13 ③): the transfer handler passes ① ② and sends payout-review/review; the worker (couli_app) re-checks payout_disabled -> queue_paused -> channel_disabled -> member_blocked (users row lock), holds with W9 on any failure, otherwise sends payout/release (dedup key withdrawal_id + execute_seq); release re-checks ① ②, the three switches, single_cap / daily_cap and withdrawals.blocked_reason under the payout_daily lock (couli_payout SELECT 0075:198) before record-then-send. Remaining window, stated honestly: a member block that appears between the worker's review commit and the release (one queue round trip) is not seen by release, since couli_payout cannot read users / balances / risk / appeals. Per D10-398 ② (payer-side failure, BR-WDR-17): W9 payer_side_after_transfer commits on the payout process's own transaction; the pause goes as payout-landing/pause to the worker, which writes payout.queue_paused on couli_app (0010:92, 0033:47); until then an in-process mark keeps the app paused. Per D10-404 the mark stores the payout.queue_paused version read under the lock and ends once a later release reads a higher version (worker persisted or admin released); if the pause job cannot be sent the mark stays and payout_pause_send_failed carries the recovery steps (set then release payout.queue_paused in the admin); automatic re-send is a follow-up. Live channel reads definite_fail_codes / payer_side_codes / query_status_map per app. Rule tests by fresh independent Claude runs (approvals #36): three test rounds, D10-398 flow changes to the frozen B2-06d / B2-06fz fixtures (D10-327, assertions unchanged; ledger #1727 / #1730 with 6 red_exempt cases whose bodies are unchanged) and the D10-404 tests #29 / #30; red PASS on the spec commit (98 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 subagents in four runs. verify:fast in the test-machine container exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/3, on 105660c2): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; review-release.int 17/17 (including #29 / #30), process/** and landing/** integration suites all passed; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check. Rebuilt on main 38eeff9b (the branch base 57e424dc predated B2-11c / B1-01zzp / B2-11d and the per-commit rebase conflicted): one test(spec) commit 299be5f1 (the five test rounds; the queue-concurrency plan follows main's evt.payout-auto-payout to 20 queues / 41 slots) and one implementation commit 0c40d6eb (the four runs); conflicts only where imports and options sit side by side (entry.ts, payout.module.ts, app.module.ts forWorker), both B2-11c's automatic-payout wiring and this task's review / pause kept. Red r9 on 299be5f1 PASS (98 red, 0 problems); verify:fast exit 0; full verify (verify/4, on 0c40d6eb) exit 124 at 3600 s with no failing case before it, review-release.int 17/17, auto-payout/** integration suites, process/** and landing/** all passed; recorded per D10-319. Guard fix (orchestrator 17:27, path-guard-author on the earlier head b47db8a2): the rule-test commit now carries only NotImplemented shells in implementation paths (pause-job.ts / review-job.ts without top-level constants; the protocol names are literals on the test side) and leaves transfer-job.ts as on main; where main's transfer path is denied on couli_payout (SQLSTATE 42501) the kit turns that rejection into an assertion failure instead of a raw error (other rejections rethrown, no assertion changed), so the red run fails by assertion; queue names, job names and the transfer-job.ts changes all sit in the implementation commit, the final tree is unchanged apart from those two test-support edits. path-guard-author PASS locally; red r11 on the new spec commit 9750bae7 PASS (98 red, 0 problems); verify:fast on the rebuilt head exit 0.
